purpose: Teach: フロリダ/クリントン/信長/ヘンリー/ハンター/つくば/赤坂/ミクロ

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがフロリダの絵本を読んで下さるそうよ
lines.en: Sho, your dad is going to read you a picture book about Florida.
lines.style: Warm, gentle sharing. Slight lift on the new information, as if offering something she knows will delight him. Soft, almost conspiratorial — like she's in on a secret with him.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんとクリントン元大統領の本見たよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I saw a book with Dad about President Clinton!
lines.style: Quick, bright excitement. Eager to share his own story back — slightly overlapping her energy, not quite waiting. Voice rises with genuine joy. Small, genuine laugh buried in the words.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが織田信長の絵本を読んで下さるそうよ
lines.en: Sho, your dad is going to read you a picture book about Oda Nobunaga.
lines.style: Same warm offer as before, but with a gentle rhythm — settling into the pattern between them. Eyes soft, slightly amused that she keeps finding new things to tell him.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんとヘンリー王子のお話聞いたよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I heard a story with Dad about Prince Henry!
lines.style: Same brightness as the Clinton line, but now he's catching on — he's matching her rhythm, excited to jump in. Slightly louder, more confident. The rhythm of back-and-forth conversation settling in.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがハンターのドキュメンタリー観てらしたわ
lines.en: Sho, your dad was watching a documentary about hunters.
lines.style: Softer this time, more observational — she's noticed something he's noticed too. Slight pause before the main clause, like she's thinking of him doing this. Warm but grounded.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんとつくば博物館行ったよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, Dad and I went to the Tsukuba Museum!
lines.style: Matching her softer tone now, but still bright. Less urgency, more presence — he's in the moment with her, sharing the memory like she's sharing his future. Steady, proud.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが赤坂の料亭で会食されるそうよ
lines.en: Sho, your dad has a business dinner at a restaurant in Akasaka.
lines.style: A shift now — slightly formal, almost careful. She's mentioning something adult, something that takes him away. Still warm, but with a thread of something underneath — resignation, or understanding.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんとミクロの絵本見たよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I saw a picture book with Dad about the Microcosm!
lines.style: Gentle warmth, almost wistful. The brightness has softened into something tender. He's holding onto the memory, savoring it. Not urgent anymore — just wanting her to know it happened, that it was real.
